text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm getting ready to go home when I notice Mejiro Dober doing warm-ups.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I still have something I want to work on. Didn't quite get it down during practice, so…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run a bit more. You can go ahead and go home.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Stop giving me that worried look. I know how to pace myself just fine.

text_block_list.text: So it's either you stay and watch or I don't get to train on my own, huh?

text_block_list.text: So it's either you stay and watch or I don't get to train on my own, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sure, whatever. Do what you want. I'll just pretend you're not here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You must be tired after today, though. You can be really stubborn sometimes, you know that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Well, if you're going to watch, you might as well give me some pointers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober pushes herself right up until curfew!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I get the feeling you won't change your mind even if I tell you I'll be careful…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I'm still itching to train, but I see where you're coming from, so I'll give in this time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Also… just to be clear, it's not like I'm unsatisfied with your training regimen or anything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober takes the time after school to rest and feels nice and refreshed!
